newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Number Nine 1997 view cut.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Number Nine 1997 view cut.

text.p: --Gruntal & Co said Friday it lowered its 1997 earnings estimate for Number Nine Visual Technology Corp to $0.11 a share from $0.30 and said it remains cautious about the company's stock.
--Gruntal said Number Nine, which provides visual technology products for desktop personal computers, is still struggling to recover from losing a large chunk of its business from Dell Computer Corp.

--The company continues to make efforts to control costs and improve its balance sheet, Gruntal said, but top line growth is dependent on its ability to push its proprietary products, which at this time remains questionable.
--Shares of Number Nine were unchanged at 5-3/8.
